name: Starliner OFT
about: Starliner OFT (2019-094A), a crewed vehicle (Starliner), launched 2019 Dec 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2019 Dec 20), held fixed
GCAT names the site (WSSH); its coordinates are written from memory
